source_caption_text:
#WendyOrtiz Shows Off Her Boxing Skills Ahead Of Her Headlining Match Against Yera At Adin Ross’ Brand Risk 😳🔥

Wendy Ortiz is a social media influencer and content creator who built a large following through TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. She originally gained attention creating videos alongside her twin sister Evelyn, and later grew her own audience with lifestyle, fashion, comedy and family-related content. She has accumulated millions of followers on TikTok and has become a recognizable personality in the creator space. 

Yera is a social media personality who has recently gained more attention through influencer boxing and her appearances with Adin Ross’ Brand Risk Promotions. Unlike Wendy, Yera already has experience inside the Brand Risk ring. At Brand Risk 15 in August 2026, she fought Tessa and earned a unanimous-decision victory, with the judges scoring the bout 29-28, 30-28 and 29-28. 

Now the two are officially matched up against each other for the main event of Brand Risk 16 on October 16, 2026, in Miami, Florida. The matchup gives Wendy her opportunity to step into influencer boxing, while Yera returns after winning her previous Brand Risk fight. Reports surrounding the event have also noted tension between the two leading into the matchup. Brand Risk 16 is scheduled to stream free across major streaming platforms.
